Your body reflects what you consistently give it.

Want to build an aesthetic physique? Start with the basics.
 Strength training gives your muscles a reason to grow.

 None of these habits need to be extreme to work.

 Build muscle naturally by mastering the fundamentals before chasing shortcuts.
 Train. Eat well. Recover. Repeat.

title: Avoidance doesn’t always look like doing nothing.
hook: Avoidance doesn’t always look like doing nothing.
caption:
Avoidance doesn’t always look like doing nothing.

Sometimes it looks like planning.
Researching.
Preparing.
Waiting until you feel ready.

Anything that lets you stay busy without facing the thing you already know you need to do.

The uncomfortable part doesn’t disappear because you avoid it.

You just carry it for longer.

Save this for the next time you catch yourself negotiating with something you know needs to be done.

Stay Unbreakable.
